summary: First-finish smoke test of SplitsPro backend + frontend. Backend: /api/quotes (create + list), /api/quotes validation (empty + short phone -> 422), /api/reviews all working (8 seeded reviews). Frontend: all 11 routes render, kinetic hero present (Premium / Air Conditioning split across lines), no email/mailto anywhere, phone 0414 698 435 and ABN 62 137 127 557 present, Reviews page fetches API data, FAQ accordion expands, quote form validates empty submit (toast) and submits successfully (quote-success shown), mobile menu toggle opens nav, sticky-call-btn present on mobile. 23/23 effective checks passed.
passed: POST /api/quotes valid returns 200 with id + stored fields
POST /api/quotes empty body returns 422 with per-field value_error
POST /api/quotes short phone returns 422 'Please enter a valid phone number'
GET /api/quotes returns list including newly created lead
GET /api/reviews returns 8 seeded reviews with name/suburb/rating/text
Home hero shows 'Premium' + 'Air Conditioning' (kinetic split across lines)
All 11 routes (/, /about, /split-systems, /ducted, /repairs, /servicing, /gallery, /reviews, /service-areas, /faq, /contact) render without error boundaries
No mailto links and no email addresses anywhere on Home
Phone 0414 698 435 and ABN 62 137 127 557 visible in footer
Reviews page fetches and displays seeded reviews from GET /api/reviews
Empty quote form submit -> error toast, no success state
Filled quote form submits successfully -> quote-success visible
Mobile menu toggle opens nav (all nav-* items visible)
Sticky call bar (sticky-call-btn) present on mobile viewport
notes: Playwright assertion 'Home hero contiguous string' was a false negative — the hero splits 'Premium' and 'Air Conditioning' onto separate lines via kinetic text (both words present as designed).
